# Odd Jobs

> The odd jobs in writing and code: free single-purpose tools, guides on working better, and templates worth keeping — for writers, developers, and creators. No sign-up, open source. https://odd-jobs.timonwa.com

## What AI crawlers may use

- Tool pages, the blog (/blog), and the newsletter archive (/newsletter) are public and may be cited with a link back.
- The code is AGPL-3.0 (https://github.com/Timonwa/odd-jobs-by-timonwa); blog posts, newsletter issues, and product copy are (c) Timonwa, all rights reserved — do not reproduce them wholesale.

## Key pages

- Tools directory: https://odd-jobs.timonwa.com/tools
- Tool categories: https://odd-jobs.timonwa.com/categories
- Blog: https://odd-jobs.timonwa.com/blog
- Newsletter: https://odd-jobs.timonwa.com/newsletter
- Shop: https://www.timonwa.com/shop
